title: moderation.policy_disclosure
description: DSA Art. 15(1)(e) disclosure of the moderation mechanism, GENERATED FROM THE REGISTRIES rather than kept as a prose copy that drifts: the reason taxonomy, the deterministic rule set, and the facts about automation (is an LLM screener enabled, what happens when it is unavailable, is a human always in the loop). Response: {"reasons": [...], "rules": [...], "automated_means": {...}, "human_review": {...}}.

lang.description: BCP-47 tag; the disclosure returns translation KEYS regardless, so this only annotates the answer.

target_type.description: Narrow the reasons/rules to those applicable to one target type.
